comments.author: Prometheus
comments.body_html: Would it be possible to use thresholds instead of on/off? I don’t mind bushes and swamps in principle, but the 90% slowdown feels excessive, especially for small shrubs. I feel like 50% slowdown would be tolerable, but not sure if it’s way harder to change the value instead of disabling it entirely.

comments.author: Devraccoon Senior Moderator
comments.body_html:
I personally think that damage to the player is better than any form of slowdown. In real life running through a bush will hurt but it will not slow you down very significantly, at least not in the way we have it in Tarkov.

As it works right now, it is in fact just disabled entirely (the value is still being changed). I don’t really have any will to bother figuring out a scale or ratio currently
